# Seed Oil Calculator
> Free tool estimating personal omega-6:omega-3 ratio and dietary inflammation risk from lifestyle inputs.

## About
seedoilcalculator.com calculates a personalised omega-6 to omega-3 ratio and Inflammation Risk Score based on cooking oil choices, processed food habits, and omega-3 intake. Results include a risk tier (Optimal / Moderate / High / Very High) and personalised reduction actions.

## Scientific Basis
- Simopoulos AP (2002) The importance of the ratio of omega-6/omega-3 essential fatty acids. Biomed Pharmacother
- WHO/FAO (2008) Dietary fats and fatty acids in human nutrition
- USDA FoodData Central — omega-6 content per food

## Key Facts
- Western diets average 15–25:1 omega-6:omega-3 ratio
- Healthy target is 4:1 or below (Simopoulos 2002)
- Vegetable/sunflower oil: ~11g omega-6 per tablespoon
- Olive oil: ~0.8g omega-6 per tablespoon
- Swapping cooking oil is the single highest-impact change
